title: UI风格#144 - Ancient Egyptian Revival (古埃及复兴)
description: 创建第144种UI风格：古埃及复兴风格 - 金字塔、象形文字、圣甲虫。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planEN.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Egyptian Revival style When color palette Then features lapis blue, gold, black, papyrus cream, turquoise
Given Ancient Egyptian Revival style When typography Then uses ancient fonts: Cinzel, Herwiga, or Tangerine
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Cinzel (headers 2.2rem 600 weight), Cormorant Garamond (body 0.95rem 400-600 weight)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Egyptian Revival style When layout Then hieroglyph borders, pyramid shapes, nile patterns, lotus motifs
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: pyramid-shaped header corners, gold border frames, Egyptian divider with ankh symbol, lapis blue/gold gradient accents

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Egyptian Revival style When UI elements Then gold leaf, papyrus texture, scarab motifs, cartouche frames
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: gold borders, papyrus texture overlay, Egyptian icons (☥𓂀𓆃𓋹𓅃), cartouche-style agent cards, hieroglyph decorations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Egyptian Revival UI When functional Then includes pharaoh chat, priest agents, temple stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Temple chat, 4 priest agents (Pharaoh Sphinx, Scribe Iris, Priest Nefertem, Guardian Horus) with Papyrus/Ankh/Scarab/Lotus/Pyramid/Obelisk/Falcon/Eye stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Ancient Egyptian Revival UI When copy Then uses ancient egyptian: 'Pharaoh', 'Scribe', 'Temple', 'Ankh'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'PHARAOH. SCRIBE. TEMPLE.', tagline '~ the Nile flows eternal ~', button 'INSCRIBE', greeting 'The gods have heard your prayer...', status 'BLESSED'/'IDLE', nav 'Temple'/'Inscribe'/'Consecrate'/'Ankh'
